title: v0.40.16
description: Ripple Preview Ripple Preview from Ricursive Intelligence is a 65B dense model built for agentic coding. ollama run ripple-preview What's Changed Qwen3.8 Flash Next uses about 27 GiB less memory on Apple silicon ollama launch claude always routes Claude Code to the selected model ollama launch explains when a cloud model has been retired /v1/responses respects truncation and no longer silently truncates by default /v1/models returns an empty list instead of null when no models are installed CUDA

title: v0.40.16-rc0: Add ripple preview support to the MLX runner (#19592)
description: Add the Ripple model, renderer, parser and import registration. Support per-layer NoPE in DFlash drafts. Fuse MLP activation, value blending and attention gating. Add reference fixtures and model/runner regression tests.

title: v0.40.15
description: MiMo V2.6 Xiaomi MiMo's mimo-v2.6 , a 9B model built for code and agent workflows, is now supported in Ollama. ollama run mimo-v2.6 AutoTrust decision models AutoTrust decision models read text and return choices, yes or no probabilities, and ratings for the questions you supply. The family includes 9b, 35b, and 27b-vl sizes — the 35b and 27b-vl sizes can also read images. ollama run autotrust-jev " A customer says their card was charged twice. " --ask " Is this a billing issue? " Note: autotrus
